polished.name: Level Ball
polished.description:
A Ball for lowerlevel Pokémon.

Level Ball's catch rate scales with the level difference between your Pokémon and the wild one. If your level is higher, the catch rate improves significantly.

This is one of the balls made from Apricorns. Specifically from Red Apricorns. It's especially useful when you're catching lower-level Pokémon for your esp when you are in overleveled for the location you are in.

There is a trick that is worth mentioning that if you lead with a Pokémon in your party that is level 1, you can use Sweet Honey to have the wild Pokémon you see also be level 1. If the Pokémon have leading behind the fainted Pokémon / the one you have out is above level 4, you can get an 8x multiplier as a bonus!

polished.name: Quick Ball
polished.description:
A Ball for early in a battle.

Quick Ball has an additional 5x multiplier when thrown on the very first turn. After that, it's just a regular Poké Ball, so don't waste them thinking its power decreases instead over turns.

This is one of the best balls in the game for catching wild Pokémon quickly. Throw it immediately on turn one and you'll catch most things without a fight. Essential for anyone who wants to catch Pokémon efficiently. I always lead with a Quick Ball before trying anything else.

Here is an additional tip for using Quick Ball - this can be really useful against roaming Pokémon. You can use a different encounter to weaken it to 1HP with False Swipe and then next encounter use a Quick Ball. This allows you to take advantage of the 5x multiplier AND the low HP bonus that you normally do not get to use together!

Liechi Berry activates when your HP falls below 25%, raising your Attack by one stage! It's gone after use but can give you the boost you need in a tight spot.
